method: Opus/WebM recordings decoded to mono 8 kHz; spectral autocorrelation discovers candidate period; independent 3 s nonoverlapping passages refine period at 2 ms resolution; raw PCM cross-correlation retained as additional evidence. Excludes the supplied 5 s ending fade and silent tails. High-confidence bounds require a 25 ms audio boundary blend; they are analyzed musical loop points, not source-engine metadata or sample-identical guarantees. Low-confidence tracks retain a full-file/fade-loop policy.
